text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc said Monday it acquired a residential water treatment business in the Los Angeles area and a bottled water dealership in San Diego County.
Financial terms of the acquistion were not disclosed.
The independent residential water treatment business is a $5-million-plus operation with significant recurring revenues, Culligan said.

The acquired bottled water dealership provides Culligan with a customer base of over 6,000 accounts and a state-of-the-art bottling plant, complementing Culligan's existing five-gallon bottled water business in the San Diego market, Culligan said.
Water treatment products company Culligan also said its Caribbean operation, Culligan-Enerserve, had begun operation of its previously announced desalination facility on the island of St. Maarten.

The new plant has the capacity to produce an average of 10,000 cubic meters of water on a daily basis for a fraction of the cost the island previously paid and is part of a five-year, $25 million contract to supply water to St. Maarten, Culligan said.
